name: Momira TC Rollover
description: Automates package rollover on momira.travel to the booking summary: clicks Book directly without changes, fills departure date (auto-scans up to +30 days if the exact date is unavailable), starts search, then stops and highlights 'Save and overwrite the existing package' for the human to accept. Reads the date from ?tcr= or #tcr=, and reports clearly when momira.travel redirected to its homepage instead of opening the package. Never clicks 'Book the trip'.
